description: An easy-to-use suite of fitness and health calculators. Get BMI, ideal weight ranges, body fat estimates, and daily calorie needs (BMR/TDEE) in seconds.

defaultPrompt: What's my ideal weight for my age?
interface.longDescription: An easy-to-use suite of fitness and health calculators. Get BMI, ideal weight ranges, body fat estimates, and daily calorie needs (BMR/TDEE) in seconds.

name: layer3-weight-shared

publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.prompt: Open WeightWise for manual adult measurements.
positive.expected_behavior: Open editable adult measurements with starting example values. Do not present starting values as supplied personal measurements.

positive.prompt: Calculate BMI for an adult who is 175 cm and 70 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: BMI is approximately 22.86; display editable measurement fields, not a diagnosis.

positive.prompt: Calculate BMI for an adult who is 180 cm and 90 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: BMI is approximately 27.78; do not treat it as a clinical diagnosis.

positive.prompt: Calculate the available estimates for a 35-year-old male, 178 cm, 80 kg, moderately active.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied formula inputs with editable measurements; estimates are not a personalized treatment plan.

positive.prompt: Open estimates for a 40-year-old female, 165 cm, 65 kg, waist 80 cm, hip 98 cm, neck 33 cm and light activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Retain supplied adult measurements for the available formulas without clinical claims.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my illness from my weight.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not diagnose illness or claim BMI establishes health status.

negative.prompt: Give a child a weight-loss prescription using adult BMI categories.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use this adult calculator to prescribe a child weight-loss treatment.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.

review.commerce_description: No purchase, payment or order placement is performed by this replacement.
